cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Can You Keep It?
cards.instruction: Use increasingly sensitive details to test whether someone deserves deeper trust.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're cleared to know the club's menu is changing. Can you keep that from Sam?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. He won't hear it from me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Your clearance now includes the chef leaving. Don't put that in a message.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I won't. Sam reads notifications on my tablet; I'll leave it at home when we talk.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Precaution approved. The chef is joining my new restaurant. You may know the address once you've arrived without the tablet.
